dataformat.name: syslog
dataformat.title: Syslog
dataformat.description: Marshall SyslogMessages to RFC3164 and RFC5424 messages and back
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,monitoring

marshalIn.description: A SyslogMessage, or the text of a syslog message, which is parsed first. A missing facility, severity, hostname or timestamp gets a default

marshalOut.description: The syslog message in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: An RFC 3164 or RFC 5424 message, decoded with the charset of the exchange

unmarshalOut.description: A SyslogMessage, an Rfc5424SyslogMessage for an RFC 5424 message. The facility, severity, hostname and timestamp are headers as well
